Aucune carte graphique dédiée détectée :: No dedicated graphics card detected: the card is missing or currently turned off (Eco mode, cardwire…).
La carte graphique dédiée est désactivée: The dedicated graphics card is turned off (ASUS power-saving mode). Turn it back on with asusctl or Armoury Crate.
L'IOMMU n'est pas actif : activez AMD-Vi: IOMMU is not active: turn on AMD-Vi / VT-d in the BIOS.
La carte graphique dédiée partage son gr: The dedicated graphics card shares its IOMMU group with other devices: it cannot be lent to Windows on its own.
The system helper is not installed.
Un écran externe est branché sur la cart: An external screen is connected to the dedicated graphics card: the card cannot be lent to Windows while this screen uses it.
La carte graphique dédiée est utilisée p: The dedicated graphics card is being used by a Linux application.
Prête : Windows utilisera la carte graph: Ready: Windows will use the dedicated graphics card the next time it starts.
